method: Monotonic wall-clock timings include a fresh subprocess, parsing, all-profile validation, 40 output renders and byte comparisons. Same repository, zero drift, captured stdout/stderr, five sequential runs per implementation. OS page caches were not flushed. Results describe this machine; no universal timing threshold is asserted.
reproduce_native: cargo test --release --manifest-path scripts/rust/Cargo.toml -p dotfile-cli --test theme_cli benchmark_theme_commands -- --ignored --nocapture
native_fixture_method: Frozen oracle fixture: first fresh process, then 20 fresh subprocesses; p50 sample index 10 and p95 index 18 after sorting. 'First' is process startup, not an OS cold-cache guarantee.
